conversations.label.description: The name of the list of the reader's conversations of direct messages, for assistive technology.

conversations.loading.description: In place of the reader's conversations of direct messages while the first of them load.

conversations.loading_more.description: What the list of direct messages says under its conversations while more load.

conversations.failed.defaultMessage: Les messages directs n’ont pas pu être chargés.
conversations.failed.description: In place of the reader's conversations of direct messages when fetching them failed; Try again follows it.

conversations.failed_more.defaultMessage: D’autres messages directs n’ont pas pu être chargés.
conversations.failed_more.description: What the list of direct messages says under its conversations when more could not be loaded, beside a button to try again.

conversations.empty.defaultMessage: Aucun message direct pour le moment. Pour en envoyer un, mentionnez quelqu’un dans une nouvelle publication et réglez sa visibilité sur Direct.
conversations.empty.description: In place of the list of direct messages when the reader has none. Who can see it is the composer's audience menu, and Direct its visibility for the mentioned accounts alone (compose.visibility.direct).

conversations.unread.description: The mark of an unread conversation of direct messages, for assistive technology.

conversations.more.description: The button of a conversation of direct messages that opens the menu of what the reader may do with it.

conversations.hide.description: The item of the menu of the direct messages with some people, in the list and over their messages, that takes them out of the list of direct messages until a new message arrives.

conversations.hide_failed.defaultMessage: Les messages directs n’ont pas pu être masqués de la liste.
conversations.hide_failed.description: The notice when hiding a conversation of direct messages failed; Try again follows it.

conversations.hidden.defaultMessage: Vous avez masqué de la liste vos messages directs avec {names}. Ils reviennent lorsqu’un nouveau message arrive.
conversations.hidden.description: The line at the top of the list of direct messages after the reader hid a conversation; there is no undo. names lists the other people of the conversation.

conversations.you.description: Says that the reader wrote a post of a conversation of direct messages: in a post's handle's place, and before the latest post's excerpt in the list.

conversations.excerpt.description: A conversation's latest post in the list of direct messages, its author first: author is who wrote it (You, or another's name in a group), in strong; text is the start of the post.

conversations.names_more.defaultMessage: {first}, {second} et {count, plural, one {# autre} other {# autres}}
conversations.names_more.description: The people of a conversation of more than three: the first two by name, and how many others.

conversations.back.description: The button at the top of a conversation that goes back to the list of direct messages.

conversations.with.description: The name of a conversation's posts, for assistive technology. names lists its other people.

conversations.conversation_loading.description: What a conversation's screen says while it loads.

conversations.conversation_failed.defaultMessage: Les messages n’ont pas pu être chargés.
conversations.conversation_failed.description: In place of a conversation's screen when fetching it failed; Try again follows it.

conversations.posts_failed.defaultMessage: Les messages n’ont pas pu être chargés.
conversations.posts_failed.description: In place of a conversation's posts when fetching them failed; Try again follows it.

conversations.gone.defaultMessage: Ces messages directs sont introuvables. Vérifiez le lien ou retournez à la liste.
conversations.gone.description: In place of the direct messages with some people when the server has none of the reader's at this address (a wrong or foreign link); the back button to the list is above it.

conversations.retry.description: The button that loads a conversation of direct messages, or the list, again after it failed.
